# quickwit_index (Resource)

A Quickwit index. The whole configuration is sent with every create (`POST /indexes`) and update (`PUT /indexes/{id}`). Build `field_mappings` and `tokenizers` with the `quickwit_field_*` and `quickwit_tokenizer` data sources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "quickwit_field_datetime" "timestamp" {
  name           = "timestamp"
  fast           = true
  fast_precision = "milliseconds"
}

data "quickwit_field_text" "service" {
  name      = "service"
  tokenizer = "raw"
  fast      = true
}

data "quickwit_field_text" "message" {
  name   = "message"
  record = "position"
}

resource "quickwit_index" "logs" {
  index_id = "logs"

  doc_mapping = {
    mode = "dynamic"
    field_mappings = [
      data.quickwit_field_datetime.timestamp.json,
      data.quickwit_field_text.service.json,
      data.quickwit_field_text.message.json,
    ]
    timestamp_field = "timestamp"
    tag_fields      = ["service"]
  }

  search_settings = {
    default_search_fields = ["message"]
  }

  retention = {
    period = "30 days"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `doc_mapping` (Attributes) How documents are parsed, indexed and stored. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--doc_mapping))
- `index_id` (String) Index identifier. Changing it recreates the index.

### Optional

- `index_uri` (String) Storage URI of the index (`s3://bucket/indexes/foo`). Defaults to the node's `default_index_root_uri` joined with `index_id`. Changing it recreates the index.
- `indexing_settings` (Attributes) Indexing settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--indexing_settings))
- `ingest_settings` (Attributes) Ingest API settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ingest_settings))
- `retention` (Attributes) Retention policy: splits older than `period` are deleted. Requires `doc_mapping.timestamp_field`. Removing the block removes the policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--retention))
- `search_settings` (Attributes) Search settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--search_settings))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `index_id`.
- `index_uid` (String) Index UID (`index_id:ulid`), new for each incarnation of the index.

<a id="nestedatt--doc_mapping"></a>
### Nested Schema for `doc_mapping`

Optional:

- `dynamic_mapping` (String) JSON options applied to unmapped fields in `dynamic` mode (same options as a `json` field: `indexed`, `stored`, `tokenizer`, `record`, `expand_dots`, `fast`). Only allowed with `mode = "dynamic"`.
- `field_mappings` (List of String) Field mappings, as JSON documents. Use the `json` output of `quickwit_field_*` data sources. Compared semantically: defaults and key order never cause diffs.
- `index_field_presence` (Boolean) Index field presence, for `exists` queries on non-fast fields. Defaults to `false`.
- `max_num_partitions` (Number) Maximum number of partitions per indexer. Defaults to `200`.
- `mode` (String) What to do with unmapped fields: `dynamic` (index them with `dynamic_mapping`, default), `lenient` (ignore) or `strict` (reject the document).
- `partition_key` (String) Partitioning expression, e.g. `tenant_id` or `hash_mod(service, 10)`.
- `store_document_size` (Boolean) Store the size of each document in `_doc_length`. Defaults to `false`.
- `store_source` (Boolean) Store the original document in `_source`. Defaults to `false`.
- `tag_fields` (Set of String) Low-cardinality fields used to prune splits at search time (text fields with the `raw` tokenizer, `i64` or `u64`).
- `timestamp_field` (String) Name of a single-valued fast `datetime` field used for time pruning and retention. Changing it recreates the index.
- `tokenizers` (List of String) Custom tokenizers, as JSON documents (`data.quickwit_tokenizer.x.json`). Tokenizers can only be added, never removed or changed, without recreating the index.

Read-Only:

- `doc_mapping_uid` (String) UID of the current doc mapping. Quickwit generates a new one each time the mapping changes.


<a id="nestedatt--indexing_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `indexing_settings`

Optional:

- `commit_timeout_secs` (Number) Maximum time, in seconds, before a document becomes searchable. Defaults to `60`.
- `docstore_blocksize` (Number) Size, in bytes, of doc store blocks. Defaults to `1000000`.
- `docstore_compression_level` (Number) zstd compression level of the doc store. Defaults to `8`.
- `heap_size` (String) Indexer heap size per pipeline (`resources.heap_size`), e.g. `2GB`, `500MiB`. Defaults to `2GB`.
- `merge_policy` (Attributes) Merge policy. Options left unset use the server defaults of the chosen `type`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--indexing_settings--merge_policy))
- `split_num_docs_target` (Number) Target number of documents per split. Defaults to `10000000`.

<a id="nestedatt--indexing_settings--merge_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `indexing_settings.merge_policy`

Optional:

- `maturation_period` (String) stable_log, limit_merge: time after which a split is mature and no longer merged (`48h`, `2days`). Server default `2days`.
- `max_finalize_merge_operations` (Number) limit_merge: merges allowed when finalizing a source. Server default `0`.
- `max_finalize_split_num_docs` (Number) limit_merge: maximum number of docs of splits merged when finalizing a source.
- `max_merge_factor` (Number) stable_log, limit_merge: maximum number of splits merged together. Server default `12`.
- `max_merge_ops` (Number) limit_merge: maximum number of merges a document goes through. Server default `4`.
- `merge_factor` (Number) stable_log, limit_merge: number of splits merged together. Server default `10`.
- `min_level_num_docs` (Number) stable_log: number of docs below which all splits are considered on the same level. Server default `100000`.
- `type` (String) Merge policy: `stable_log` (default), `limit_merge` or `no_merge`.



<a id="nestedatt--ingest_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ingest_settings`

Optional:

- `min_shards` (Number) Minimum number of ingest shards. Defaults to `1`.
- `validate_docs` (Boolean) Validate documents against the doc mapping at ingest time. Defaults to `true`.


<a id="nestedatt--retention"></a>
### Nested Schema for `retention`

Required:

- `period` (String) Retention period, e.g. `30 days`, `1 week`.

Optional:

- `evaluation_schedule_jitter` (String) Maximum random delay added to each evaluation, e.g. `10min`.
- `schedule` (String) When the policy is evaluated: `hourly`, `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly` or a cron expression. Defaults to `hourly`.


<a id="nestedatt--search_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `search_settings`

Optional:

- `default_search_fields` (List of String) Fields searched when a query does not name one.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing index by its index_id.
terraform import quickwit_index.logs logs
```
